decisions.reason: Although this schlager compilation CD is close to the firm's existing curation and label capabilities, it is an older 2018 title and such niche physical releases are often allowed to run off once demand becomes predictable and limited.

This illustrated music release series builds directly on the firm's established strengths in curated physical music and related media, so its high relatedness makes management more willing to keep learning from it and continue offering it.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP sits squarely in the firm's core knowledge of reissues for collectors, and in a growing market for physical media that makes it relatively likely to be retained.

The multi-disc box set is still close to the firm's expertise, but these expensive collector editions are often finite-run products, so by 2022 management would be somewhat more likely to let it leave the market than keep allocating resources to it.

Even though the compilation CD is related to the firm's existing offer, its weaker website presence and more standard format suggest lower commitment and a higher chance that management will discontinue it within the next year.
